messages:
maria: ACME asked for a clean upgrade path that preserves customer-assigned egress IPs without requiring a full cluster reprovision. they want an SLA doc and a low-touch installer change. can we propose options and launch gates?

aj: two options I see: 1) operator shim that intercepts CNI + routing updates and binds existing EIPs to new nodes (minimal data movement). 2) rolling-replace where nodes are drained and reattached to the old egress IPs via cloud provider APIs (simpler but more downtime risk).

luke: operator-shim is attractive for customers who cannot reassign public IPs. tradeoffs: installer must support a toggle and we need validation of current EIP attachments. also need to surface failure reasons.

sasha: ACME requires audit history of egress-ip assignments and an explicit SLA clause: "preserve-if-possible with <1hr disruption". theyre ok paying for a short migration maintenance window but want rollback guarantees.

maria: MVP proposal: 1) installer flag `--keep-egress-ip` to enable shim mode, 2) a preflight tool `ri-preflight check-egress` that verifies mappings and permissions, 3) telemetry events `egress.preserve.attempt` / `egress.preserve.result`, 4) an audit log export of eip assignments. launch gate = preflight pass on AWS + 1 pilot customer + runbook available.

aj: implementation note: shim will add an egress-preserve controller that watches Node objects and ensures EIP claims are honored. installer profile snippet: ```yaml
installer:
  onprem:
    network:
      keep_egress_ip: true
      claim_label: "redwood.io/egress-preserve"
```

luke: provider adapters needed: AWS (EIP + ENI attach), GCP (static nat IP mapping), Azure (PublicIP resource). i'll prototype AWS adapter first--we should design an adapter interface: claim -> provider-bind -> health-check -> release.

deploy-bot: ticket created RDW-9345 "egress-preserve: installer flag + operator shim + preflight" assigned to @aj; checklist added.

sasha: legal/support: we'll add a rollback clause: if preservation fails, customer will be offered automated staged fallback or immediate revert with documented consent. also need SLA wording for measurable metrics (time-to-recover, percent-of-ips-preserved).

maria: launch criteria (draft): A) preflight success across supported clouds (AWS=required), B) automated integration tests + chaos injection pass, C) telemetry & audit export validated by support team, D) 1-2 pilot customers complete migration under monitored window, E) docs + playbook published. any criterion failing blocks launch.

aj: rough estimate: shim core + tests = 2 sprints, AWS adapter = 1 sprint, GCP/Azure adapters = 1 sprint combined, preflight + docs + pilot = 1 sprint. total ~5 sprints if done serially. can parallelize adapters after AWS MVP.

luke: agree prioritize AWS. will mock provider API failure modes (rate limits, attach conflicts) in the prototype.

sasha: i'll draft customer comms and contract addendum for rollback and SLA; will also prep support-runbook templates for escalations (who to page, what logs to collect). :white_check_mark:

maria: next steps: aj opens RFC PR for `--keep-egress-ip` installer flag and controller API; luke to deliver AWS adapter prototype; sasha to draft contract language and runbook; weekly sync Friday 10am. thanks everyone.
